title: Implement exchangeDiscordCode Cloud Function for web app authentication
description:
The web app (photo-7ht.12) requires a Cloud Function `exchangeDiscordCode` to complete the Discord OAuth2 flow.

The function needs to:
1. Receive authorization code from client
2. Exchange code for Discord access token (requires client secret)
3. Fetch user info from Discord API
4. Create Firebase custom token with Discord user ID as UID
5. Return custom token and user info to client

Without this function, users cannot authenticate with the web app.

Reference: web/src/services/auth.ts line 52-55
